Description: Bessemer Trust is a multifamily office providing private wealth management, investment management, wealth planning, and family office services to individuals and families of wealth. Founded as a family office in 1907, it offers multidisciplinary advice and operational support across generations.

Rockefeller Capital Management is an independent financial services firm offering wealth management, asset management, and strategic advisory services. Its Rockefeller Global Family Office provides tailored wealth-management services to individuals and families, including ultra-high-net-worth clients.

DFO Management, formerly MSD Capital, is the Dell family investment office. It invests globally across public and private equities, credit, real estate, and other asset classes using a flexible, long-term strategy.
Principal Job Title: Founder of MSD Capital (now DFO Management); Founder, Chairman and CEO of Dell Technologies

Description: Silvercrest is an independent, employee-owned registered investment adviser providing investment advisory and portfolio-management services to individuals, families, institutional investors, and endowments and foundations. It also provides comprehensive family office services, including tax, estate, philanthropic, concierge, risk, and reporting support.

Mousse Partners is a New York-based family office and investment division of Mousse Investments Limited that oversees a proprietary global portfolio across public and private markets. It invests across a broad range of asset classes, partnering with external investment managers and investing directly alongside management teams, entrepreneurs, and institutional investors with a long-term view.

The New York-based Lauder family office is an investment vehicle associated with Ronald S. Lauder and the broader Lauder family. Public sources describe investments across media, telecommunications, real estate, consumer businesses, private equity, and venture capital.
Principal Job Title: Chief Executive Officer, RSL Investments Corporation

Description: Euclidean Capital is a New York-based family office founded by James H. Simons and Marilyn H. Simons. It manages investments for the Simons family and associated foundations.

Willett Advisors manages Michael R. Bloomberg’s personal and philanthropic investment assets, including Bloomberg Philanthropies. It pursues long-term capital appreciation through a diversified portfolio spanning public markets, hedge funds, private equity and credit, real assets, and direct investments.

Tiedemann Advisors is an independent multi-family wealth and investment advisory firm serving ultra-high-net-worth families, foundations and endowments. Its services include investment management, estate and wealth planning, trust and fiduciary administration, family-office administration, governance, tax, philanthropy and impact investing.
Principal Job Title: Founding Partner and Chief Executive Officer of Tiedemann Advisors; advisory capacity at AlTi Global

Description: BBR Partners is an independent boutique wealth management firm and multi-family office serving a select group of wealthy families. It provides customized investment management, multidisciplinary wealth advisory, and portfolio administration and reporting.

Hillspire, LLC is an integrated family-office management company serving Eric and Wendy Schmidt's business, investment, and philanthropic activities. It provides legal, finance, accounting, real estate, human-resources, and information-technology services while managing investments across public securities, private equity, real estate, and other alternatives.

Stonecroft Management is the investment office founded in 2022 to manage capital for Henry R. Kravis. It invests in venture and growth-stage companies across technology, financial services, and software.

The D. E. Shaw Group is a global investment and technology development firm investing across public and private markets. It uses quantitative tools, fundamental analysis, technology, and disciplined risk management across strategies including hedge funds, private markets, active equity, and multi-asset investing.

Soros Fund Management is a global asset manager and family office serving as the principal asset manager for the Open Society Foundations. It invests globally across public and private equity, credit, fixed income, foreign exchange, macro and alternative assets.
Principal Job Title: Chief Executive Officer and Chief Investment Officer

Description: A New York single-family office managing the Ziff family's wealth and diversified investments across private equity, hedge funds, real estate, public equities, and venture capital. The family's wealth originated from the Ziff Davis media business.

Tsai Capital is a New York-based investment management firm managing separately managed account portfolios for high-net-worth individuals, retirement accounts, family offices, and charitable organizations. It uses a long-term, fundamental, research-driven approach to growth investing focused on preserving and growing capital.

MacAndrews & Forbes is a privately held investment and holding company that owns and operates a diversified portfolio of businesses. Its investments span industries including cosmetics, biotechnology, defense, entertainment, financial services, and gaming.
Principal Job Title: Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, MacAndrews & Forbes

Description: Red Apple Group is a privately held conglomerate that owns and operates assets in energy, real estate, finance, insurance, supermarkets, and media. Its businesses include energy refining and distribution, New York-focused real estate, Gristedes supermarkets, and WABC Radio.
Principal Job Title: Founder, Owner, President, Chairman, and CEO

Description: Paulson & Co. is a New York-based private investment office and family office founded by John Paulson. Founded as a hedge fund in 1994, it converted to a private investment office in 2020 after returning all external investor capital.

Advance is a private, family-held business founded by S.I. Newhouse and his family that owns and invests in companies across media, entertainment, communications, technology, education, and other growth sectors. It provides patient, long-term capital and supports portfolio-company leadership to build value.

Aeonic Partners is a New York-based private investment firm and family office using permanent capital to partner with management teams and build sustainable businesses over the long term. It focuses on control and selected structured minority investments across business services, healthcare, education, technology, financial services, and value-added distribution.

Pershing Square is an alternative asset management and investment firm that invests through permanent-capital vehicles in concentrated positions in high-quality businesses with defensive market positions, predictable free cash flow and attractive valuations. It may act as an engaged investor to help create long-term value.
Principal Job Title: Founder, Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of the Board

Description: Aeterna Capital Partners is a family office-backed private investment firm focused on direct investments in lower middle-market companies. It provides flexible financing solutions across the balance sheet, including private equity, mezzanine debt, and select fund-level investments.

Ziff Brothers Investments describes itself as a private family investment firm based in New York City, investing across public equities, fixed income, commodities, macro trading, and other areas. It does not accept outside capital.

Cherner Capital is a multi-generational real estate-focused investment firm and family office based in Washington, D.C., and New York City. It makes equity and debt investments in real estate and other assets and businesses with a long-term focus on preserving and growing wealth.
Linden Global Strategies is a New York-based wealth management advisory firm and multi-family office. It provides financial planning, investment management, and consulting services.

Cisneros is a privately held global enterprise operating across media, digital solutions, telecommunications, real estate, mobility, consumer products, and new technologies. Its portfolio builds and scales businesses and long-term projects across global markets.

Vision Logiq Digital presents itself as a growth and digital intelligence company building integrated search, AI visibility, paid media, reputation, conversion, and revenue-acquisition systems for businesses.

Stardust is a multidisciplinary family office working toward a future where all women and girls can fulfill their potential through Equity, Fund, and Arts. Its investment arm partners with fund managers and entrepreneurs pursuing commercial, sustainable solutions with positive social and environmental impact.

Fairfield-Maxwell is a third-generation family-owned enterprise founded in 1957 that buys, builds, and grows companies across industries and geographies through long-term capital investments. It partners with family-owned businesses, entrepreneurs, owners, and management teams, providing management expertise, operational expertise, and permanent capital.

Lepercq Group is a privately held investment firm managing family and generational capital through global investments in public and private securities, assets, and companies. It also provides tailored capital and operational support to business partners.
Principal Job Title: Chairman, Chief Executive Officer & Co-Chief Investment Officer

Description: Bryant Stibel is an investment and operating platform founded in 2013 by Kobe Bryant and Jeff Stibel. It provides strategy, capital, and operational support to businesses across technology, media, and data, partnering with companies to unlock value and drive sustainable long-term growth.

AtlanVest is a New York-based single-family office and permanent-capital private investment vehicle founded by Pierre Mordacq. It focuses on U.S. private-market growth and buyout investments, investing directly or alongside partners.

Fingerboard Family Office is a New York-based single-family office managing the assets of the extended Newhouse family, founders and owners of Advance Publications. Its investment office oversees the family office, family foundation, and Advance's corporate liquid assets.
Principal Job Title: Chief Investment Officer, Treasury and Fingerboard Family Office, Advance

Description: The R-Group is a Portland-based single-family office of Rany and Estee Raviv that makes seed-stage, angel, and venture-capital investments primarily in fintech, high technology, lifestyle, and consumer packaged goods.

Jolimont Global Mining Systems was an Australian investment firm focused on high-growth mining equipment, technology and services companies. Resource Capital Funds acquired it in 2019, with its principals continuing the mining-innovation strategy within RCF.

SassCorp is the Sassoon family’s private investment and operations holding vehicle across Asia Pacific and the Americas. It invests in retail, food and beverage, technology, real estate, education, and venture funds.

The Cooper Family Office is a private single-family office managing the investments of the Cooper Family of Florida and accepts no outside clients or external capital. It invests globally across hedge funds, private equity, venture funds, direct operating companies, real estate, and other opportunities.

39 North Capital is a principal investment firm that partners with owner-operators and strategic investors in mature, cash-generating businesses, structuring standalone investments rather than a pooled fund. It focuses on long-term value creation in multi-unit retail, health and wellness, beauty, and business and residential services.

J. Hunt Holdings is a family investment holding company that provides capital and functional expertise to early-stage ventures, primarily in technology and telecommunications. It invests approximately $100,000 to $1.1 million per project and works actively with founders and management teams, often alongside other investors.

Eastbridge Group is a family holding company and investment platform with approximately $1.5 billion in assets under management. It invests across real estate, growth equity, early-stage equity, private equity funds, hedge funds, and multiple operating sectors in the United States, Europe, and Israel.

Accretion Capital is an operator-led family-office investment platform focused on long-term ownership through venture capital and real estate. It invests through founder, operator, and global networks using disciplined, control-oriented structures.

Adamo Capital is a family office supporting families in managing their economic, social, health, and time wealth. Its services cover investment advice and deal sourcing, legal and audit support, controlling, and lifestyle, health, and logistics.

Addison Capital is a privately owned private equity firm partnering with owners and operators of smaller middle-market, often family-owned businesses, providing liquidity, growth capital, legacy stewardship, and management resources.

ADIFO provides wealth advisory and bespoke family-office services for families and individuals. Its services include asset protection and strategic planning, consolidated reporting, and customized open-architecture investment advice.

ASI Family Office provides wealth management and financial planning for individuals, families, and businesses. Its services include family governance, legacy and estate planning, tax planning, insurance oversight, investment management, real-asset investing, and performance reporting.

Aviano Ventures, LLC is the Janca family’s private investment company and family office. It invests its own capital in companies and commercial real estate, with a focus on healthcare IT, tech-enabled pharma, information technology, data analytics, and AI/ML technologies.
Kirra Capital is a Miami-based, operator-led investment firm that acquires and operates B2B SaaS platforms and makes minority investments in technology companies at pivotal growth stages.

BigSur is an independent global multi-family office providing personalized, unbiased wealth management and investment advisory services to high-net-worth families. It helps clients build, preserve, enjoy, and transfer wealth through customized solutions for complex, multi-jurisdictional relationships.

Kent Capital Investments is a private family office and investment platform that makes direct, long-term investments in diversified industries, primarily healthcare, with hands-on strategic and operational support for early- and growth-stage ventures.

Klosters Capital is an SEC-registered RIA and multi-family office providing independent, customized wealth-management and investment advice. It serves local and Latin American clients through portfolio management and access to traditional and alternative investments, including private equity and real estate.

Larch Capital Partners is a Miami-based multi-family office specializing in wealth management. It provides personalized, independent and transparent wealth and investment-management solutions tailored to each family's circumstances.

On Par Capital is a Miami-based, family-owned firm specializing in private equity, real estate investments, and real estate and asset-based lending. It allocates capital to growth equity and real estate debt and equity while providing partners with guidance and hands-on support.

The Miami Family Office is a U.S.-based single-family office focused on direct investments in real estate and operating businesses. It also seeks co-investors, acquisition targets, and additional direct investment opportunities.

BLD Holdings is a Boca Raton single-family office founded by Barry Dorfman. It focuses on investments in life sciences, technology and health, and participates as a co-investor across a broader network investing in real estate, venture capital, private equity and hedge funds.

Sagamore Ventures, formerly Plank Industries, is a privately held family office and investment company with holdings in commercial real estate, hospitality, food and beverage, and venture capital. Its mission is to execute the Plank family's initiatives, support portfolio growth, and contribute to economic development in Baltimore City.

RDV Corporation is a Grand Rapids-based single-family office serving the DeVos family. It provides investment and professional services including private equity, finance and accounting, tax, philanthropy, technology, talent management, and domestic, household, and property services.
